T: Before he created the music, he lived every bit of it.
D: A young Minneapolis musician fights for his band's slot at First Avenue while his home life and his love life fall apart.
P: Serve the cobbler when The Kid dedicates the new song to his father.
S: Crumbed fish bites with tartare. Apollonia jumps in to purify herself, not in Lake Minnetonka.

Stir the mayo with the capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon. Whisk the flours, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a light batter. Dip the fish and fry in oil at 180C in batches until crisp. Drain, salt and serve with the tartare and lemon wedges.
500g firm white fish fillets, cut in bite-size pieces@Seafood
Salted soft pretzel bites. Morris and Jerome mangle the password.

Roll the dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Drop them in batches into simmering water with the bicarb for 30 seconds, then drain. Brush with egg, sprinkle with salt and bake at 220C until deep brown. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until thick, then melt in the cheddar and mustard.
M: Jerk chicken charred on the grill with lime. The Time get the club moving with Jungle Love.

Rub the chicken with the jerk paste and oil. Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, beans, spring onions, thyme and 250ml water, covered, until tender. Grill the chicken over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through. Char the lime halves on the grill. Serve the chicken on the rice and peas with the lime.
Cheese-stuffed Jucy Lucy burgers, molten in the middle, keep the change.

Divide the mince into 8 thin patties. Fold 2 slices of cheese into a square on 4 patties, top with the others and pinch the edges tightly shut. Cook in a hot pan, 5 minutes a side, pricking once so the steam escapes. Serve in buns with onion, pickles and mustard, and warn everyone the cheese is molten.
W: Blackberry cobbler, purple and bubbling, with vanilla ice cream.

Toss the berries with 100g of the sugar and the cornflour and tip into a baking dish. Rub the butter into the flour and the rest of the sugar, then stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls over the fruit and bake at 190C until golden and bubbling. Stir the vanilla into the cream and pour over to serve.
K: Blackcurrant cordial and lemon topped with sparkling wine. Apollonia 6 debuts at First Avenue.
Put 20ml cordial, a squeeze of lemon and 3 frozen blueberries in each of 4 flutes. Top slowly with the sparkling wine.
